latestVersion.changelog:
AI Music Video Maker skill — initial release.

- Instantly turns a 3-minute MP3 and 10 photos into a 1080p music video via AI and cloud rendering.
- Simple upload (audio, images), describe your result, then download a polished video — no timeline editing required.
- Automatic cloud session/token setup with 100 free credits (no account needed at first).
- Supports quick exports, credit checks, draft previews, and uploading in multiple formats (mp4, mp3, jpg, etc.).
- Fast render pipeline (1–2 minutes per video) with clear error handling and user feedback.
